top_signals.title: Hold interest rates but ‘sound hawkish’, City AM Shadow MPC tells Bank of England
top_signals.summary: The Bank of England should hold interest rates on Thursday, City AM’s Shadow Monetary Policy Committee has said, after a string of economic data prints showed the threat of spiralling inflation had eased. The Shadow MPC – a group of economists compiled by City AM – said a series of economic data releases had suggested [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
